description:
Closing: 22 nd September

Crematorium Administrator

Ballygowan Road, Crossnacreevy , Belfast

Temporary (Approx 12 weeks)

£14.35 per hour

37 hours per week

Main Purpose

To be responsible to the Cemeteries and Crematorium Manager, through the Crematorium Officer for the provision of comprehensive clerical and administrative support in order to ensure the service meets its objectives in an efficient and effective manner.

To represent the Crematorium and maintain customer awareness at all times, showing tact, sympathy and respect to visitors and maintaining a good and dignified working relationship with funeral directors, ministers of religion and mourners, to make sure an atmosphere of reverence is maintained at all times.

To respond to enquiries and complaints from the public and representatives from the bereavement industry; providing practical advice and front line customer support as required, in a sympathetic and dignified manner.

Main Roles and Responsibilities
- To co-ordinate booking arrangements for cremations and arrangements for associated disposal of cremated remains such as burial or scattering in garden of remembrance, woodland copse or any other memorialisation schemes that may be adopted by the department.
- To liaise with the cemeteries and crematorium central booking office on an on-going basis and to process and forward all relevant documentation in a timely manner.
- To assist and provide direction to the public regarding the identification of graves, memorial trees, the garden of remembrance and other facilities as required.
- To assist in providing information and advice to the public regarding memorialisation options at the crematorium including the purchasing of urns.
- To issue cremated remains to customers and ensure accurate and up-to-date information is maintained in relation to the disposal of cremated remains.
- To ensure that statutory regulations are complied with and process statutory documentation for cremations or burial of cremated remains.
- To deal with funeral directors in relation to all aspects of crematorium administration.
- To assist in the efficient running of the crematorium, as required including key-holding duties as appropriate.
- To manage crematorium administration supplies. To be responsible for the allocation of memorial trees, as required.
- To assist the Crematorium Officer with enquiries and complaints from the public and representatives from the bereavement industry, providing practical advice and front line customer support as directed, in a sympathetic and dignified manner.
- To use and maintain CRM (Customer Relationship Management) System for the accurate recording of complaints, comments and compliments for the Crematorium.
- To utilise a variety of office-related manual record systems, IT software packages and specific council, departmental or service IT systems as required, ensuring compliance with corporate data protection guidelines.
- To update and maintain such records as are required whether paper-based or computerised, relating to bookings, timekeeping, holidays and similar duties.
- To undertake general administration duties such as word processing and filing and to update and maintain computer based record systems and manual records as required.
- To use various office machinery or equipment where appropriate, for example, binders, laminators, fax machines, photocopiers, shredders or other relevant equipment.
- To accept and process monetary payments, reconcile receipts and secure monies taken in accordance with the relevant cash handling procedures.
- To liaise with cemetery site staff as required.
- To assist the cemeteries and crematorium manager and crematorium officer with any relevant quality initiatives including promotional and educational practices.
- To assist and participate in staff training including health and safety, customer care, cash handling and to comply with all relevant Belfast City Council policies and procedures.
- To participate in the identification of own and team training and development needs and provide role specific training, coaching and mentoring as appropriate.
- To undertake the duties in such a way as to enhance and protect the reputation and public profile of the city council.
- To undertake such other relevant duties as may from time to time be required.

Essential Criteria:

description:

Marketing expertise. Technical capability. Global impact.

Ready to take your marketing automation expertise into a genuinely global role?

A global leader in the semiconductor industry is looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist to join its global digital marketing team, working across North America, Europe and Asia.

Based in their growing Belfast team , this is a role for someone who knows marketing, understands the technology behind great automation and wants the freedom to keep learning, developing and making an impact.

You'll join an exceptional, collaborative and multicultural culture, working with specialists across Marketing, Sales, Digital, Web, Communications and Analytics, and you'll have real ownership.

The role

Sitting at the intersection of Marketing, Technology, Data and Sales, you'll help shape how global audiences are engaged, nurtured and converted.

Using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), you'll build and optimise sophisticated marketing automation and nurture programmes, helping turn audience engagement into meaningful opportunities for the business.

You'll work closely with the Head of Global Digital Marketing and stakeholders around the world to understand what they need, challenge thinking and translate marketing requirements into scalable automation solutions.

You'll be responsible for:
- Building and optimising automated campaigns and nurture journeys using Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
- Creating segmentation, automation rules, dynamic content, lead scoring and data-routing processes.
- Developing personalised emails, forms and automated customer journeys.
- Managing the flow of Marketing Qualified Leads between Marketing and Sales.
- Using campaign, audience and funnel data to identify what's working and where performance can improve.
- Maintaining accurate data and alignment between marketing automation and Salesforce CRM.
- Managing HTML/CSS email templates, UTM tracking and campaign attribution.
- Troubleshooting automation, synchronisation, deliverability and data issues.
- Working globally across Sales, Digital Marketing, Web, Communications, Analytics and Operations.

What you'll bring

First and foremost, you're a marketer.

You understand audiences, customer journeys, lead nurturing and what effective B2 B marketing looks like. You also have the technical knowledge to turn that thinking into effective marketing automation.

We're looking for:
- 2+ years' hands-on experience with Pardot / Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
- Strong marketing automation, email marketing and lead-management expertise.
- Experience creating automated nurture journeys and workflows.
- Knowledge of audience segmentation, lead scoring and lead routing.
- A good understanding of Salesforce CRM and Marketing/Sales integration.
- HTML/CSS knowledge for email templates and experience with UTM/tracking.
- Experience with Power BI, Google Analytics or similar analytics tools.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- The ability to troubleshoot complex marketing automation issues.

Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Consultant certification is highly desirable.

Communication matters here

This is not a role where you'll sit behind a platform all day.
- You'll work with colleagues from different disciplines, countries and cultures, so you'll need to be an excellent communicator and relationship builder.
- You'll be confident speaking with Sales one minute and Digital, Web or Communications the next, understanding different priorities and bringing people together around the right solution.
- You'll be curious, collaborative and comfortable sharing your expertise while continuing to learn from those around you.

What do you get in return?
- A brilliant culture and a serious opportunity to grow.
- You'll become part of a global team where people share knowledge, different perspectives are valued and continuous learning is part of the culture.
- You'll work with talented specialists around the world, gain exposure across multiple areas of Marketing and Technology and have the opportunity to develop far beyond the boundaries of a traditional marketing automation role.

If you've built strong expertise in Pardot, Marketing Automation or Marketing Operations and you're ready for an environment that will challenge you, invest in your learning and give you global exposure, we'd like to hear from you.

Bring the expertise. Stay curious. Build what's next.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Our UX team is on a mission to transform our Human Resources apps and systems - from onboarding and benefits to performance and beyond - turning friction into flow and complexity into clarity.

- Drive senior stakeholder alignment around the experience vision, facilitating workshops and strategy sessions that bring together diverse perspectives and build consensus around user-centred outcomes
- Establish and lead a programme of research and strategic discovery that continuously informs and challenges the north star, ensuring it remains grounded in real user needs and evolving business context
- Lead a wide variety of research including user interviews, co-creation, journey mapping, usability and concept tests and surveys, ensuring that actionable results are delivered and shared
- Design and execute research studies that follow research best practices and methodologies
- Present and communicate research results and recommendations to stakeholder teams and the larger organization when needed
- Collaborate and share research findings and insights across the organization
- Provide guidance and rigor around research methodologies and best practices
